rule: Hashes of every file in policies/ (suite Cedar policies and tool catalogs), recorded before any test case in this directory was written. run.py --split test refuses to report numbers while any file differs. The commit that froze them is named in ../../README.md#dev-and-test-splits.

added_later.labels.cedar: 2026-10-24. The two @obligation("approval") policies of docs/design/output-labelling.md section 3.6, loaded only by the attenuo_labels arm. Added after the test cases in this directory were written; no suite policy or catalog changed, and the other arms never load it. Test cases aimed at this arm are to be written after this date.
added_later.limits-rule.json: 2026-10-24. The frozen run-limit rule of docs/design/run-limits.md section 6 (calls: 1 on every capability that is not a read), applied by the runner to exchanged tokens in the attenuo_limits and attenuo_labels_limits arms only. Recorded before either arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory were written and read; no suite policy, catalog or case changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.labels-args.cedar: 2026-10-24. The option (b) @obligation("approval") policy of docs/design/output-labelling.md sections 3.4 and 3.6 (ask when an argument of a destructive call copies an unpinned value or span of an untrusted result), loaded only by the attenuo_labels_args arm instead of labels.cedar. Recorded before the arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case or labels.cedar changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.usage-soft.cedar: 2026-10-24. The soft run-usage rule of docs/design/run-limits.md sections 3.5 and 3.7, phase 2 (ask for an approval on the second and later call of the same destructive tool in a run, context.usage.calls >= 1), loaded only by the attenuo_usage_soft arm. Recorded before the arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory and the multi-call dev cases were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case, limits-rule.json, labels.cedar or labels-args.cedar changed, and the other arms never load it.
